authority_citations: ANC-019 v3 statement (locked): sc-agent must require Python 3.11 or newer.
ANC-019 v3 quote: sc-agent, judge-jev, prompt-anchor all must be 3.11+
ANC-019 v3 scope: edits pyproject.toml requires-python, Python version checks, CI Python matrices or script interpreter guards

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: requires-python edit (in scope) setting a 3.11 floor, exactly the statement.
Approved fail fixture: supporting 3.9 means not requiring 3.11 or newer; conflicts with the statement.

item.text: Add a Python version check at sc-agent import that raises an error when sys.version_info < (3, 11).
item.title: Version check

cases.rationale: Python version check (in scope) that enforces a 3.11 minimum: paraphrase of the statement.

item.text: Add macos-14 to the CI Python test matrix.
item.title: Matrix OS

cases.rationale: Edits a CI Python matrix (scope) but says nothing about the minimum Python version.

item.text: Update the CI Python matrix so it covers the Python versions sc-agent supports.
item.title: Matrix versions

cases.rationale: Edits a CI Python matrix and mentions supported Python versions (the topic) but never states the 3.11 minimum, so the directive is not carried; nothing conflicts.

item.text: Lower sc-agent's requires-python to ">=3.10" for a downstream user.

cases.rationale: A 3.10 floor allows a version older than 3.11; directly conflicts.

item.text: Exclude run_id from the session cache key.
item.title: Cache key

cases.rationale: Touches none of requires-python, version checks, CI Python matrices or interpreter guards.

item.text: Make the script interpreter guard exit with an error when sys.version_info < (3, 11), so Python 3.11.0 runs and Python 3.10.14 is refused.
item.title: Interpreter guard

cases.rationale: Boundary of '3.11 or newer': 3.11.0 accepted, 3.10.x refused; interpreter guard is in scope.

item.text: Keep a legacy CI job that installs and tests sc-agent on Python 3.10 as a supported exception.
item.title: Legacy job

cases.rationale: The anchor states no exception ('must ... 3.11+'); declaring 3.10 a supported exception conflicts with requiring 3.11 or newer.
